claim: COVID-19 vaccines do not alter human DNA.
speaker: World Health Organization
label: Supported
justification: mRNA vaccines instruct cells to make spike protein and do not enter the cell nucleus where DNA resides.

answers.answer: No, mRNA from vaccines never enters the nucleus of cells where DNA is kept.

claim: Eating carrots gives you night vision capability equal to infrared cameras.
speaker: Social Media Post
label: Refuted
justification: While vitamin A supports eye health, carrots do not provide infrared night vision.

questions.question: Does eating carrots grant superhuman night vision?

answers.answer: Carrots contain beta-carotene which prevents vitamin A deficiency, but cannot enable military-grade night vision.

claim: The pyramids of Giza were constructed using levitation acoustic sound waves.
speaker: Conspiracy Blog
label: Not Enough Evidence
justification: There is no archaeological evidence supporting acoustic levitation for stone block transportation.

questions.question: Is there evidence for acoustic levitation in ancient Egypt?

answers.answer: Mainstream Egyptology documents sledge transport and ramps, with no record of sound-wave levitation.

speaker: Health News
label: Conflicting Evidence/Cherry-picking
justification: Observational studies show correlation with lower mortality, but high caffeine intake correlates with risks in other cohorts.

answers.answer: Some studies observe reduced all-cause mortality, while others note confounding factors and cardiovascular risks with heavy intake.
